Channel.description: A channel: the release one, built from the packaging, or a snapshot of upstream branches.

epoch_bump.description:
Snapshot only: what is added to the changelog's epoch in its deb versions, so that they
supersede packages installed from elsewhere.
epoch_bump.title: Epoch Bump

fallback.description:
Snapshot only: the channel whose state provides the dependencies this channel does not
build (default: the release channel).
fallback.title: Fallback

kind.description:
``release`` for the one channel built from each package's own packaging, ``snapshot`` for
one built from upstream git commits.
kind.title: Kind

version_label.description:
Snapshot only: the label of its upstream versions, ``<tag>+<label>.<n>.g<sha>`` (default:
the ref's name, every character outside ``[A-Za-z0-9]`` turned into ``.``; the channel's name
for a package pinned by ``commit``).
version_label.title: Version Label

Channel.title: Channel

Distrib.description: A distribution to build for, keyed by its id (``debian``, ``fedora``).

extra_repositories.description: The repositories of other packages its builds depend on, signature-checked.
extra_repositories.title: Extra Repositories

gpg.description: The key that signs its packages and repository.

repository.description: The repository its packages are published in.

versions.description:
The releases to build for: codenames, versions, ``supported``, ``testing``, ``sid``,
``all``, and ``available``, which keeps only those whose builder image is published.
versions.title: Versions

Distrib.title: Distrib

ExtraRepository.description:
A signed repository of other packages the builds depend on (another project's).

The builds install from it with a lower precedence than the project's own packages, and the
repository's page tells its users to add it first.

components.description: The components of a Debian family repository.
components.title: Components

key.description: The file of the public key that signs it, relative to build.conf's directory.
key.title: Key

key_url.description: The URL its users download that key from, for the page.
key_url.title: Key Url

name.description:
Its short name, in the file names of its configuration (default: extra-<its index>):
letters, digits, `_` and `-`, which apt and dnf accept in their file names.
name.title: Name

suite.description: The suite of a Debian family repository, a template as url.
suite.title: Suite

url.description:
Its URL: of the whole repository for the Debian family, of a release's directory for the
rpm families; ``{codename}``, ``{version}`` and ``{suite}`` are replaced from the release. A
``file://`` URL names a directory of the build's host, mounted into the build.
url.title: Url

ExtraRepository.title: ExtraRepository

Gpg.description: The OpenPGP key that signs a distribution's packages and repository.

file.description: The file holding the secret key, relative to build.conf's directory.
file.title: File

id.description: The fingerprint or key ID of the key to use, when the file holds several.
id.title: Id

uid.description: The user ID of the key to use, in the changelog entries (default: the key's first one).
uid.title: Uid

Gpg.title: Gpg

Package.description:
A package to build, keyed by the name of its directory.

The directory holds ``debian/`` for the Debian family, ``<name>.spec`` for the Fedora family,
or both. A 3.0 (quilt) deb source downloads its upstream tarball as ``debian/watch`` says; an
rpm, as its spec's ``Source:`` lines say.

channels.description: The snapshot channels that build this package, and its upstream source in each.
channels.title: Channels

disable.description: The releases, per distribution id, not to build this package for (release tokens).
disable.title: Disable

Package.title: Package

PackageChannel.description: Where a snapshot channel takes a package's upstream source from.

commit.description: The full hash of the commit to build, pinned by the packaging (trusted as it is).
commit.title: Commit

git.description: The URL of the upstream git repository, used as written.
git.title: Git

ref.description: The branch whose head to build, or whose commit given to ``fetch --snapshot``.
ref.title: Ref

verify.description: With ``ref``: ``none``, or ``{keys: <file>}`` for a commit signed by one of its keys.
verify.title: Verify

PackageChannel.title: PackageChannel

ReleaseTool.description: The settings of the release tool (``distropack-build pending`` and ``release``).

author.description:
The author of the changelog entries it writes, ``Name <email>`` (default: from git's
``user.name`` and ``user.email``).
author.title: Author

distribution.description: The distribution of the deb changelog entries it writes.
distribution.title: Distribution

packages.description:
Globs of the packages a release updates (default: every package with a snapshot
channel).
packages.title: Packages

ReleaseTool.title: ReleaseTool

Repository.description: The repository the packages of a distribution are published in.

channels.description: Where each channel is published, when not as the defaults say.
channels.title: Channels

description.description: The repository's label, in its Release file and its .repo file (default: its name).
description.title: Description

name.description:
The repository's short name, in the keyring and .repo file names (default: the URL's last
path component).
name.title: Name

path.description: Where the repository is written, relative to build.conf's directory.
path.title: Path

url.description: The URL the repository is served from; without it, no installation page is written.
url.title: Url

Repository.title: Repository

RepositoryChannel.description: Where a channel is published, for one distribution.

component.description:
Debian family: the component holding the channel (default: ``main`` for the release
channel, the channel's name for a snapshot one).
component.title: Component

description.description: Fedora family: the repository's label, as the distribution's ``description``.
description.title: Description

name.description: Fedora family: the repository's short name, as the distribution's ``name``.
name.title: Name

path.description:
Fedora family, snapshot channels: the directory of the channel's own repository, relative
to build.conf's directory (required).
path.title: Path

url.description:
Fedora family, snapshot channels: the URL that repository is served from (required when
the distribution's repository has one).
url.title: Url

RepositoryChannel.title: RepositoryChannel

VerifyKeys.description: Check that the commit built is signed by one of the keys of a file.

keys.description:
The file of the OpenPGP public keys allowed to sign it, relative to build.conf's
directory.
keys.title: Keys

VerifyKeys.title: VerifyKeys

channels.description:
The channels, keyed by name: exactly one ``kind: release``, any number of ``kind:
snapshot`` (default: one release channel, ``stable``).
channels.title: Channels

distribs.description: The distributions to build for, keyed by id.
distribs.title: Distribs

packages.description: The packages to build, keyed by the name of their directory, beside build.conf.
packages.title: Packages

release.description: The settings of the release tool.
